name: cavemio-approval-card
title: Approval card
description: The agent asks before it acts: what it wants to do, the details, Approve or Deny.

cavemio.accessibility:
- The card is a labelled group in every state; the outcome is announced from a status region inside it, so screen readers hear "Approved: Send email to 3 people".
- When you answer, focus moves to the card itself rather than dropping to the page as the buttons fold away. The folded body is inert.
- The countdown is not a live region, so it never chatters; its digits are hidden from assistive tech and the time is real text.
- Installs Number roll and Text morph. With reduced motion, the card changes state in place.
- Approve is never focused automatically, so a stray Enter can’t approve an action.
- Details wrap rather than truncate, because they are what the user is approving.
cavemio.previewNote: Interactive local fixture. Data and async results are simulated in the preview; the caller supplies application services.

props.name: title / description
props.description: – · What the agent wants to do, in plain words.

props.name: details
props.description: – · The specifics worth checking: recipients, amounts, files.

props.name: reason
props.description: – · Why approval is needed, e.g. the AI SDK’s requestReason.

props.name: status / defaultStatus
props.description: "pending" · Controlled, or let the card remember the choice.

props.name: onApprove / onDeny
props.description: – · Send the decision back to your agent.

props.name: approveLabel / denyLabel
props.description: "Approve" / "Deny" · Name the actual action, e.g. "Send" and "Don’t send".

props.name: destructive
props.description: false · Red Approve for deletes, payments and other irreversible actions.

props.name: expiresAt / onExpire
props.description: – · Countdown to when the request lapses.

useCases.title: AI agent chats
useCases.description: Ask before the agent sends an email, deletes files or spends money.

useCases.title: Payments and billing
useCases.description: Ask before a refund, a plan change or a large payment goes out.

useCases.title: Workflow tools
useCases.description: A step that waits for a person’s go-ahead before the run continues.

useCases.title: Admin tools
useCases.description: A sign-off before something that can’t be undone, such as deleting a project.

features.title: It says what will happen
features.description: A title, a description and a list of the specifics worth checking, such as recipients, amounts or files.

features.title: Approve or Deny
features.description: Name the real action (“Send” and “Don’t send”) and get onApprove or onDeny back.

features.title: Red for irreversible
features.description: Set destructive for deletes and payments and Approve turns red.

features.title: It becomes the receipt
features.description: The same card folds into one line, “Approved” with a drawn check, rather than being swapped for something new.

features.title: Requests can expire
features.description: A countdown rolls down like a clock and the card folds into “Expired” when it reaches zero.

features.title: Hard to approve by accident
features.description: Approve is never focused automatically, so a stray Enter can’t approve an action.

states.title: pending
states.description: The request with its details and Deny / Approve. With expiresAt, a countdown whose digits roll down each second (00 rolls back to 59, like a clock).

states.title: approved
states.description: One motion over 480ms: the body folds shut and blurs out, the padding tightens, the action slides into the header line, the label morphs to "Approved" and an emerald check draws itself in place of the shield.

states.title: denied
states.description: Folds the same way into "Denied" with a ban icon; the agent carries on without it.

states.title: expired
states.description: The countdown reaches 0:00, folds away with the body, and the label morphs to "Expired".
